en: “Balls invade hobby online shops”
Finally, Ball K type and Shark Mouth Ball are now available at HGUC! !
[HGUC 1/144 RB-79K Ball K type]
Characteristic parts are completely reproduced with new parts!
• In addition to the K-type's distinctive arms and booster, it also features a unique winch and headlight.
Completely reproduced with new parts
• Complex color reproduction is faithfully reproduced by molded colors.
• Dedicated stand included
[HGUC 1/144 RB-79 Ball (Sharkmouth specification)]
The large marking uses Kynas Seal and can be easily pasted on any situation!
• In addition to the shark mouse mark that appeared in IGLOO episode 3, marks such as the playing card mark that appeared in IGLOO episode 5 are also included.
• Characteristic shapes such as arms, windows, and boosters are fully reproduced with additional parts.
• Dedicated stand included
• Set contents:
HGUC 1/144 RB-79K Ball K type x 1
HGUC 1/144 RB-79 ball (shark mouth specification)]×1
